intro_lead: I'm a senior software engineer with {{years}} years of experience building consumer apps in React Native, React and TypeScript.
intro_body: I started as an intern in 2019 and have worked from early-stage startups to Coinbase, where I own sign-in, sign-up and account flows used by millions of people every month. I raised test coverage on critical authentication packages from 60% to 86% and built AI tooling adopted by about 90 engineers. I'm {{age}}, love to travel, and enjoy sharing what I learn through writing and open source.
challenge_1: Building AI-native tooling, such as agents, skills and shared context, that helps engineering teams move faster.
challenge_2: Growing into backend work and architecture, so I can design and ship full-stack features end to end.
challenge_3: Deepening my native Android and iOS knowledge to build better mobile experiences.
